name: spit-language
description: Live diagnostics for SPIT pipeline files

spit.executablePath.description: Path to the SPIT executable. Leave empty to use a sibling SPIT build or the executable on PATH.

spit.sourcesFile.description: Inventory file for this pipeline. Relative paths are resolved from the pipeline file. Leave empty to use a sibling file with the same name and a .sources extension, when present.
